theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y v : Euclid P) (ρ₀ : ℝ), 0 < ρ₀ → μ (closedBall y ρ₀) ≠ ∞ → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ ≤ 1) → ‖v‖ = 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → ∃ ρ₂ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₂ ∧ ρ₂ ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ₂ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (μ (closedBall y r)).toReal ≤ ∫ z in closedBall y r, inner ℝ (ν z) v ∂μ
